question: What is the research field of the paper titled 'Attention Is All You Need'?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?field ?fieldLabel WHERE {
  orkgr:R12345 orkgp:P30 ?field .
  ?field rdfs:label ?fieldLabel .
}

question: Which benchmarks are used to evaluate the BERT model?
sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?benchmark ?benchmarkLabel WHERE {
  orkgr:R67890 orkgp:P71 ?benchmark .
  ?benchmark rdfs:label ?benchmarkLabel .
}
